rules: Second Founder cannot qualify from support evidence alone.
People's Charter cannot qualify while pred.final_charter_prerequisites is producer-unresolved.
Iron Crown cannot be inferred from security alone.
Golden Compact cannot be inferred from treasury strength alone.
Steward cannot be inferred from institutional evidence while a permanent-emergency blocker remains active.
Broken Diadem is a failure family and must not be used as a positive fallback merely because another ending is unresolved.
Quiet Throne requires its own authored withdrawal/stability evidence and is not a generic fallback.
Support nodes E267-E270 do not become final ending predicates without an explicit contract.
Replay/meta evidence cannot satisfy a fresh-run ending prerequisite without an explicit promotion rule.
E33/E34 are canonical production events; E33 emergency_power and constitutional_limit, and E34 people_heard, remain evidence/flags until explicit ending-consumer contracts exist.
E33/E34 boundary validation must be case-sensitive against the canonical event IDs and must not depend on graph-node presence alone.
E273-E277 remain excluded from the E01-E272 production freeze.
required_runtime_resolution: exact positive prerequisite set per family
exact negative blocker set per family
tie-break order when multiple families qualify
